open_questions: Exact plans_required_single_family thresholds, load_calculation method/worksheet, EV charger load factor, sheet_size, signature_or_stamp, and job-specific city submittal checklists could not be verified because El Cajon's Document Central PDFs ('Residential EV Charging Checklist', 'Expedited Photovoltaic Application', 'Photovoltaic - Fire Code Installation standards', 'Owner Builder Form', and 'Permit Application' in folder-39) could not be opened directly.

Full body text of El Cajon Municipal Code Chapter 15.92 (Sections 15.92.030, 15.92.035, 15.92.037, 15.92.040, and 15.92.050 covering solar, advanced energy storage systems, and EV charging stations) was only indexed by section title in the October 14, 2025 agenda PDF; opening the full Chapter 15.92 municipal code text would confirm city-specific streamlined permitting and submittal requirements for EV chargers and solar with battery storage.

Specific conditions printed on El Cajon's 'Owner Builder Form' (such as occupancy duration or affidavit wording beyond Municipal Code Section 15.24.020) require opening the PDF in Document Central folder-39.

Whether single-family standby generators, subpanels, service upgrades, or 240 V appliance circuits qualify for over-the-counter issuance without plan review in El Cajon requires accessing the Building Permits and Forms subpages linked from https://www.elcajon.gov/your-government/departments/community-development/building-fire-safety-division.

El Cajon's Building Permits, Photovoltaic Permits, and Forms subpages linked from https://www.elcajon.gov/your-government/departments/community-development/building-fire-safety-division (including https://www.elcajon.gov/your-government/departments/community-development/building-fire-safety/photovoltaic) were not indexed or accessible to extract verbatim job-specific submittal checklists or over-the-counter eligibility rules.

The PDFs listed in Building Division Document Central—including 'Residential EV Charging Checklist' (https://www.elcajon.gov/discover-el-cajon/advanced-components/custom-documents-images-calendar/-item-2878/-toggle-all/-sortn-EDate/-folder-39/-npage-3), 'Owner Builder Form', 'Permit Application', and 'Photovoltaic - Fire Code Installation standards' (https://www.elcajon.gov/discover-el-cajon/advanced-components/custom-documents-images-calendar/-item-526/-sortn-EDate/-toggle-all/-folder-39/-sortd-asc/-npage-2)—could not be opened directly to verify their contents, revision dates, or load calculation requirements.

The exact effective date of the 2025 California Electrical Code adoption ordinance in the October 14, 2025 City Council agenda (https://public.destinyhosted.com/elcajdocs/2025/CC/20251014_271/270_10-14-25%20agenda%20full%20-%203PM.pdf) could not be verified verbatim from the indexed excerpt.
No City of El Cajon-published residential electrical load calculation worksheet, mandatory NEC 220 method, EV charger service load factor, or plan sheet size standard was found on elcajon.gov.
